description: Your organization's SIEM has captured unusual authentication patterns in the last few hours. As the on-call security analyst, you must investigate the log data in ManageEngine EventLog Analyzer to determine what is happening. Your tasks are: (1) search the log data to identify which user account is being targeted in a brute-force attack and from which source IP the attacks are primarily originating, (2) create a threshold-based alert profile in EventLog Analyzer that will trigger when this attack pattern recurs — use the account name you discovered, set severity to Critical, and trigger on 5 or more failed authentication events within 5 minutes, and (3) document your complete findings in a file at ~/Desktop/incident_report.txt. The report must include: the targeted username, the attacker source IP address, the total number of failed attempts you observed, and your recommended remediation steps. Log in with username: admin, password: admin.
